name: KANOHAR ELECTRICALS LTD
summary: Kanohar Electricals Limited engages in the transformer manufacturing business for industries including power transmission, railways, renewable energy, and power distribution in India. The company operates through two segments; transformer manufacturing business; and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction Business. It manufactures transformers across various capacities ranging from 132 kV to 400 kV. The company's products include power transformers, traction transformers, Scott transformers, Shunt reactors, and distribution transformers.
